Record from subtable values.description: Collect all same-subtable values into one record

Record from subcolumn headers + subrow.description: N items from the same subcolumn (headers) + one from the same subrow

Attribute from same column (column-major.description: Associate with an attribute from the same column, column-major traversal

Fixed string attribute.description: Associate with a constant string attribute

Join same-cell item.description: Join (drop anchor) another item from the same cell

Fill forward from same column.description: Fill forward from same-column values with a delimiter

Prefix with nearest value above.description: Prepend the nearest value above, with a separator

Table skeleton: header row + data rows.description: Header row of attributes followed by repeated rows of values

Row skeleton.description: Row pattern: first cell + repeated cells

Settings prefix.description: Table pattern settings: normalization and anchor attribute position
